request:
镜头 s36：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 9 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：只做专业化补全（没有选择风格预设）。保持导演意图里写到的外观，不添加任何胶片、机身、调色或导演风格。
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：手持近景，手电的反光照着她的脸。宋念看着笔记本最后一页，眼眶红了，轻声念出来。环境声：安静、远处隐约的警报。
情绪：moved, quiet, resolute
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：close-up, handheld, nearly still
景深与虚实：Her eyes sharp, the notebook edge and the room soft.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Raw verité close-up in her dark cramped apartment during the blackout (steel wall and the round porthole window softly behind her, no monitors): Nian's face in the bounce light of the flashlight, eyes wet but steady, reading the last page of the notebook held close. Blocking lock: Nian's face at frame centre-right, the notebook edge at frame lower left catching the flashlight; darkness behind.
Picture 2: Nian (Song's daughter, dispatch engineer, 33 in 2075, 36 in 2078) (character reference; role: the daughter, now grown up). A Chinese woman in her mid-thirties, dispatch engineer of an underground city: straight black shoulder-length hair tucked behind her ears with short side-swept bangs, calm guarded tired eyes, faint lines, a round face grown lean. Dark grey dispatcher uniform jacket with a high collar, a light headset around her neck.
Picture 3: Song's notebook with the crayon drawing taped on the first page (prop reference; role: prop reference). A worn hardback engineer's notebook lying open: on the first page the child's crayon drawing (a big black box with one red eye and many small smiling coloured boxes holding hands) is taped in with yellowed tape; around it and across the facing page, an adult's dense pencil diagrams of networks, many small circles linked by lines, arrows and loops spreading outward. Only abstract shapes, no legible words or numbers.
Picture 4: Nian's cramped apartment in the underground city (location reference; role: location reference). A cramped family apartment in an underground city: steel walls, a narrow bunk bed, a small wall screen glowing blue, a round porthole window looking out on the lit shaft of the city, a folding table with a teapot and a worn notebook. Empty of people, dim.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Nian (a woman in her mid-thirties, low, calm, restrained voice) — 宋念（三十多岁女性的声音，低沉、平静、克制）: 要是它有了自己的想法……我们就得有彼此。

现场环境声：near silence, a faint distant alarm
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[rules/move/documentary-handheld] move
[ours/cam-verite-follow] 机位：纪实手持跟拍
[rules/move/handheld-slight] move
[ours/sound-crisis] 声音：危机现场
[ours/pace-doc] 节奏：纪录片的呼吸
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。
